review_scope: Independent read-only source review of DODGE-056 failed055 handoff helper and CPU fixtures. No helper dispatch, live ledger mutation, native game, MPS work, evaluation, or promotion.

findings.trigger: Pass an output path whose parent resolves to QUEUE but whose final directory is an existing symlink to a directory outside QUEUE. The parent check passes, mkdir(exist_ok=True) follows the symlink, and claim plus all handoff receipts are written through it.
findings.consequence: Dispatch evidence is not confined to the coordinator-owned queue namespace. This weakens the expected immutable receipt location and can direct durable files into an unrelated path.
findings.corrective_action: Reject symlink output paths and require the resolved output directory to be a direct child of QUEUE before creating or writing it. Add a temporary-directory test using an output symlink to an external directory; assert rejection before claim, ledger mutation, or external writes. Obtain a fresh exact-source review.
